sections.label: Shoe soles
sections.evidence: Black bricks make two separate low footprints at x=6–11 and x=12–17, both extending from z=7 to z=15 at y=0.

sections.label: Right leg and shirt side
sections.evidence: Black bricks complete the right shoe, gray bricks rise through y=2–6, and blue bricks continue above them into the shirt and outward sleeve at x=14–18.

sections.label: Left leg and waist
sections.evidence: Black bricks complete the shoe at x=6–11. Gray courses rise at x=7–11 through y=6, followed by blue waist bricks at y=7.

sections.label: Shirt and sleeves
sections.evidence: Blue bricks fill the torso across x=6–15, z=10–16, y=8–12, with sleeve extensions on both sides. Brown #190 begins the neck above the shirt.

sections.label: Neck and face
sections.evidence: Brown bricks build the neck at y=13 and broaden into the head through y=17. Black #199 and #211 lie along the lower front face; brown projections extend to either side.

sections.label: Hair cap
sections.evidence: Black bricks cover the head at y=18–19 over x=7–15, z=8–16. These steps also add brown #240 beneath the cap and several blue shirt pieces.

sections.label: Raised hand and fork
sections.evidence: Blue sleeve bricks surround x=15–18; brown bricks form the hand at z=6–9. Gray #173 and #210 extend upward beside yellow #188. Black #235 adds an eye detail.

sections.label: Plate of spaghetti
sections.evidence: White bricks form a dish at y=8–10, z=2–10. Yellow pieces occupy its center, while red #147, #150 and #151 form a topping at y=11.

sections.label: Left hand and face details
sections.evidence: Brown #86, #92, #118 and #122 form the hand beside blue sleeve pieces at x=4–5. Brown #227 and #241 extend the head side, and black #233 marks an eye.
